name: batch-5ue
_note: Compact 5-UE baseline batch (docs/SCENARIO_EDGE_PROFILES.md §8.2): round 1 rotate 0 A-B-C-D, round 2 rotate 2 D-C-B-A. Rotation moves every profile/group to other phones (camK runs on cam((K+2) mod 5)'s laptop) to separate phone placement from profile effects; the reversed order balances slow drifts (e.g. interference windows) across scenarios. 8 x ~5.7 min = ~46 min. batch-5ue-round3.json adds a third rotation (4) if time allows.
